# Project Instructions

- Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only. No external libraries, CDN links, Google Fonts, npm, package.json or build tools. Draw any charts or bars with plain HTML/CSS or inline SVG.
- All data is fake and lives in data.js. Never call an outside website or API.
- Only fictional players, teams and managers. No real NFL players or team names, and no real company or app names or logos anywhere on the site.
- No login, password or payment forms of any kind.
- Never remove the footer that says this is a student prototype.
- Everything must work on a phone (375px wide) and on a laptop.
- Keep the existing single-page setup: sections with data-view that app.js shows and hides.
- Wrap any localStorage use in try/catch.
